title: NTV Android TV v1.2.2
changelog:
• Direct TV Remote 0-9 numeric channel entry with on-screen badge.
• Pre-launch zombie cleanup & direct ProcessBuilder for embedded engine stability.
• EPG display-name and alias matching for curated Zee and sports streams.
• M3U playlist parser support for #KODIPROP DRM keys and tvg-chno numbers.
• Native Android TV AudioAttributes for system audio focus handling.
• Rate-limit resilient OTA update checks via Fastly raw GitHub CDN.
